tools.name: vercel_projects
tools.description: Vercel projects, most recently changed first, each with its framework, git repository, production URL and the state of its production deployment.

team.description: A team's slug or id. Default: the one chosen in Sikemux.

tools.name: vercel_deployments
tools.description: A project's deployments, newest first, each with its state, Production or Preview, branch, commit message, author, age and URL.

project.description: The project's name or id. Without one, every project's.

state.description: BUILDING, ERROR, INITIALIZING, QUEUED, READY or CANCELED; several joined by commas.

branch.description: Only deployments of this git branch.

tools.name: vercel_deployment
tools.description: One Vercel deployment: its state and any error, target, URL and aliases, git branch and commit, who made it, and its inspector link.

id.description: A deployment id such as dpl_…, or its URL.

tools.name: vercel_logs
tools.description: A deployment's build log, the last lines first cut to `tail`. Read it to find why a build failed.

id.description: A deployment id such as dpl_…, or its URL.

tail.description: How many of the last lines. Default 200, at most 2000.

tools.name: vercel_redeploy
tools.description: Build a deployment's source again as a new deployment, to the same target unless `target` says otherwise. Only when the person asked for it.

tools.name: vercel_promote
tools.description: Make a ready deployment production without building it again. Promoting an older deployment rolls production back. Only when the person asked for it.

id.description: The deployment to serve in production.

tools.name: vercel_cancel
tools.description: Stop a deployment that is queued or building.

tools.name: vercel_domains
tools.description: A project's domains, whether each is verified, and the branch or redirect each one serves.

tools.name: vercel_env
tools.description: The names of a project's environment variables, with the targets and branch each is set for. Their values are never given.

tools.name: vercel_env_change
tools.description: Set or remove a project's environment variable. A value is only sent, never read back. Only when the person asked for it.

value.description: For set; left out, it stays.

id.description: One of several with this key.

tools.name: vercel_domain_change
tools.description: Add, route, verify or remove a project's domain; answers with the DNS records it still needs. Only when the person asked for it.

tools.name: vercel_runtime_logs
tools.description: A project's requests with their status, and what its functions logged, newest first, from the last `minutes` (default 15, at most 30).
